extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that is any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Function x^n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form f(x)=x^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x) when c is constant.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The property that a function has a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function with a variable exponent, such as a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number such that lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit Definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Defines e by the limit lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm base e, appearing in d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function giving position as a function of time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the first derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the cost function: MC=C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function giving cost as a function of quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity describing how one variable changes with another.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A sum of power functions with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation Rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules for computing derivatives, including power, sum, and constant multiple rules.
